title: 第3章 我果然是天才第4章 懂得都懂
lines: 被乐临清甜言蜜语短暂迷惑了下，许平秋试探的问道：“那个，你调转方向应该是想回去抓那个狗东西吧？”
“嗯。”乐临清点了点头，有些紧张的说道：“这是我第二次执行宗门任务，上一次也差点失手，所以这次……”
她话还未说完，许平秋的目光落在了乐临清身侧的面具上。
他指了指那个诡异的物件，问道：“这个面具是他的东西，现在调转方向回去，他会不会感知到？”
许平秋回想着之前那面具能够控制自己动作，导致他无法动弹，但是在上了纸鹤后不久自己就可以动弹，显然是超过了面具的控制距离。
眼下若是带着面具再靠近那狗东西，理论上来说会跟蓝牙耳机重连一样在她那里疯狂弹窗吧。
这不等于明目张胆的告诉她，狗东西爷又肥来了抓你这个崽种了。
“好像是诶……”乐临清仿若被点醒了，恍然大悟，连忙翻手将面具收起，咻的一下就不见。
这一手许平秋倒不是很意外，毕竟乐临清之前的药膏也是这样拿出来的，这应该就是传说中的储物法器啥的。
只是许平秋想起乐临清的双手并没有佩戴戒指类的饰品，目光便又好奇的往她身上打量了起来。
可她的腰间除了裙子的丝绦外，也并没有类似储物袋的东西，身上也没有佩戴多余的饰品，显得利落飒爽。
这令许平秋心中浮现出了一个疑问，面具是被乐临清藏哪去了。
“怎么了？”乐临清感受着许平秋的目光，有些不解的问道。
在发出疑问前，她略微举起双手，低头目光审视了一下自身，并没有发现什么问题。
“我在想，你把东西收哪去了？”许平秋如实相告。
“虚窍中啊。”乐临清一副理所应当的语气，甚至有些疑惑许平秋为什么会问这种问题。
但片刻后，她才想到，许平秋可能并不懂修行。
她思索了一会，很快便想到了一种通俗易懂的说法：“就是修炼之后，咻的一下就会开辟出一个空间，我们称之为虚窍，就是给修行者装东西用的啦。”
说着，她还用手比画了一下开辟的情形。
“这样啊……”
虽然许平秋没有看懂，但还是肯定的点了点头，然后搓了搓手，热切的问道：“那你能不能帮我瞅瞅，我有没有修行天赋？”
“哦，好啊。”乐临清没有拒绝他的要求，欣然应允，
这对于她来说并不困难，而且也算是弥补一下之前的误会了。
毕竟自己之前将剑顶在他的脖子上，还倒拽的他走了好一会，要不是他用奇怪的方式引起了自己的注意，只怕到府城后那才是真的糟糕。
于是乐临清凑近了一些，将手搭在了许平秋的手腕上，一边解释道：“人天生会具有灵脉，这不同于经脉，只需要具有十三条，那么就可以吞吐灵力进行修行了。”
“虽然看起来要求数量很少，但其实也很苛刻，我也不是说咒你啦，只是你要做好一下心理准备。”
但此刻的许平秋根本听不见乐临清的话。
在她的手搭上来的时候，他就感觉有什么东西瞬间顺着手腕进入到了自己的身体，有一种暖洋洋舒服的感觉。
她的手搭上来的瞬间，一道暖流自腕上渗入，初始如春水初融，涓涓而行，转瞬却似江河决堤，奔涌着冲刷他四肢百骸！这暖流带着一种怪异的酥麻，令许平秋身体很不争气的软了下来，直接啪嗒的往乐临清身上倒去。
“诶……”乐临清有些始料不及，慌乱的用另一只手去扶许平秋的身体，但他的头宛如穿甲弹一般精准的击中了乐临清的平板装甲。
想象中的天崩地裂没有传来，令许平秋未曾想到的是，在乐临清平平无奇的外表下，竟然传来了一种减震感！
与此同时，乐临清的东西总算在他的体内逛了一圈，然后匆匆的抛弃了许平秋而去，令他感觉所谓的灵脉中有些空虚。
正当他想要坐直身子时，那股暖流又突然涌了回来。
这一次，来势汹汹，令许平秋猝不及防。
“你…你干嘛？
content_en:
Briefly confused by Le Linqing's sweet words, Xu Pingqiu asked tentatively: "Well, you changed direction because you wanted to go back and catch that bitch, right?"
"Yes." Le Linqing nodded and said nervously: "This is my second time performing a sect mission, and I almost missed it last time, so this time..."
Before she finished speaking, Xu Pingqiu's eyes fell on the mask beside Le Linqing.
He pointed at the strange object and asked, "This mask belongs to him. Now if we turn around and go back, will he feel it?"
Xu Pingqiu recalled that the mask could control his movements before, causing him to be unable to move. However, he was able to move soon after getting on the paper crane, which was obviously beyond the control distance of the mask.
If you were to get close to that piece of shit while wearing a mask, theoretically speaking, pop-ups would pop up on her like a Bluetooth headset reconnecting.
This doesn't mean to blatantly tell her that the fat bitch is here again to catch you, a little bastard.
"It seems..." Le Linqing seemed to be awakened, and suddenly realized, he quickly turned his hands to put away the mask, and it disappeared with a whoosh.
Xu Pingqiu was not surprised by this move. After all, Le Linqing had taken out the ointment in this way before. This should be the legendary storage weapon or something.
But when Xu Pingqiu remembered that Le Linqing's hands were not wearing rings or other accessories, he looked at her curiously.
But apart from the silk ribbon of her skirt, there was nothing like a storage bag around her waist, and she didn't wear any extra accessories, making her look neat and cool.
This made Xu Pingqiu wonder where the mask was hidden by Le Linqing.
"What's wrong?" Le Linqing felt Xu Pingqiu's gaze and asked with some confusion.
Before asking the question, she raised her hands slightly, lowered her eyes and looked at herself, but found no problem.
"I was wondering, where did you put your things?" Xu Pingqiu told the truth.
"I'm in a void." Le Linqing said in a matter-of-fact tone, even a little confused as to why Xu Pingqiu would ask such a question.
But after a moment, she realized that Xu Pingqiu might not know how to practice.
She thought for a while, and soon came up with an easy-to-understand explanation: "After practicing, a space will open up in a blink of an eye. We call it a virtual orifice, which is used for the practitioners to store things."
As she spoke, she also gestured with her hands to illustrate the opening.
"That's it..."
Although Xu Pingqiu didn't understand, he still nodded affirmatively, then rubbed his hands and asked eagerly: "Then can you help me see if I have any talent for cultivation?"
"Oh, okay." Le Linqing did not refuse his request and readily agreed.
This is not difficult for her, and it can be regarded as making up for the previous misunderstanding.
After all, he had put his sword on his neck before and dragged him away for a long time. If he hadn't attracted his attention in a strange way, it would have been really bad when he arrived in Fucheng.
So Le Linqing came closer, put his hand on Xu Pingqiu's wrist, and explained: "People are born with spiritual veins, which are different from meridians. You only need to have thirteen, then you can absorb spiritual power and practice."
"Although the requirements may seem small, they are actually very demanding. I'm not saying I'm going to curse you, but you have to be mentally prepared."
But at this moment, Xu Pingqiu couldn't hear Le Linqing's words at all.
When her hand came up, he felt something instantly enter his body along his wrist, giving him a warm and comfortable feeling.
The moment she put her hand on it, a stream of warmth seeped into his wrist. At first it was like the melting spring water, running trickling, but in the next moment it was like a river bursting its embankment, rushing to wash away his limbs and bones! This warm current had a strange numbness, which made Xu Pingqiu's body soften unsatisfactorily, and he fell directly onto Le Linqing.
"Eh..." Le Linqing was a little surprised and used his other hand to support Xu Pingqiu's body in a panic, but his head hit Le Linqing's flat armor as accurately as an armor-piercing bullet.
The imaginary earth shattering did not occur. What Xu Pingqiu never expected was that under Le Linqing's ordinary appearance, there was actually a sense of shock absorption!
At the same time, Le Linqing's things finally wandered around in his body, and then hurriedly abandoned Xu Pingqiu and left, making him feel a little empty in his so-called spiritual veins.
Just when he was about to sit up straight, the warmth suddenly came back.
This time, Xu Pingqiu was caught off guard by the force of the attack.
"You...what are you doing?
